_readme: Pages the weekly workflow watches. Each entry maps a gov.uk guidance page to the register rows it affects, so a change notice tells the reviewer exactly which rows to look at. Add or remove entries freely; the workflow reads this file, nothing is hardcoded.
_api: https://www.gov.uk/api/content + base_path. Public, no key, no rate limit published. Only base_path is required per entry.

sources.label: Placing UKCA or CE marked products on the GB market
Placing manufactured goods on the market in Northern Ireland
Product safety alerts, reports and recalls

_notWatched.eur_lex: EUR-Lex has a web service and a SPARQL endpoint. Not wired up yet: it needs a query per instrument rather than a page poll, so build it once the gov.uk watcher is proven.
_notWatched.cen_cenelec: Paywalled. Editions and Dates of Withdrawal for the EN 60335 and EN 62368 families stay manual, forever.
_notWatched.etsi: Deliverables are published free at etsi.org, so the radio standards can be automated later. Not yet built.
